headline: LIU top the table as FDU win the last meeting
dek: FDU went to LIU on Sunday and won, reversing a defeat on the same ground in October, though LIU still finished top of the conference table. FDU's 13 wins are the most of any NEC side; their latest result is a heavy defeat at Cornell.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Howard and Chicago State scored fewer goals between them than FDU did alone; above that pair, the rest of the conference scored at much the same rate, and the table was settled by what each side conceded.

wire.line: Chicago State conceded 74 goals, more than Le Moyne, Mercyhurst, Central Connecticut and FDU together.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: LIU finished top of the table with a losing record across the whole season: seven wins, one draw and eight defeats.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Tal Levy scored 11 of LIU's 28 goals.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Mercyhurst drew six matches, more than any other programme in the conference.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Jabullie Mooketsi made 148 saves in goal for Chicago State and was still beaten 59 times.

last_match.line: FDU arrived on a winning run that included Sunday's win at LIU.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
